title: Onboard arcadia-7b v1.0: performance profiles, metadata and changelog automation
author: Priya Kulkarni
release_notes: Add Arcadia-7b v1.0 to model catalog with curated metadata and performance profiles. Includes automated changelog generation on registry updates and a small doc page describing when to prefer arcadia variants. No breaking API changes.
description: Context: Onboard arcadia-7b v1.0 into the registry with validated metadata and Redwood performance profiles. Motivation: Arcadia shows promising latency/cost trade-offs for mid-length conversational workloads and should be available to customers through the registry with out-of-the-box perf tuning. This PR adds model metadata, perf profiles for common instance types and sequence lengths, and a lightweight changelog automation script that appends an entry when new model metadata or perf profiles are merged. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata (name, family, compatible formats, quantization notes) - [x] Generate performance profiles (latency/cost for 512/1024 tokens on T4/A10/GPU types) - [x] Add unit and integration tests for onboarding path - [x] Add docs page and brief usage notes - [x] Add changelog automation to keep release notes in sync Summary of changes: see commits. Performance validation: benchmark harness (perf-canary) run on T4 and A10; median latency within expected bounds and matches profiles included. Changelog automation: automation/changelog-generator.py scans models/*/metadata.yaml and perf/* and appends a standardized entry to registry/CHANGELOG.md on merge; it includes a safeguard that prevents duplicate entries for the same model-version. Rollout plan: merged to main, will be picked up by the nightly registry publish job and visible in the hosted catalog in the next deploy. Related: ENG-4271 (model onboarding tracking), PM-881 (product sign-off).
commits_summary: 1) Add metadata.yaml for arcadia-7b v1.0; 2) Add perf profiles JSON and CSV summaries; 3) Add changelog-generator automation + tests; 4) Update registry index and docs page; 5) Fix unit tests and CI flake based on reviewer feedback.
review_comments: Liam Chen: Please add a description for the quantization behavior (fp16 vs int8) in metadata.yaml so ops teams know compatibility constraints. Also add a perf profile for 256-token prompt path.
Priya Kulkarni (author): Added quantization notes and included 256-token perf profile in profiles.json. Re-ran canary benchmarks and updated bench CSVs.
Ava Rodriguez: Changelog script looks good. Suggest adding idempotency test to ensure duplicate merges don't create multiple entries.
Priya Kulkarni: Added unit test that runs changelog-generator against a snapshot directory and asserts a single entry is written per model-version. CI green locally.
Noah Patel: CI flaked on lint step due to line-length in docs; fixed and re-ran. Approved after CI passed.
ci_summary: All checks passed after one lint fix and a perf re-run. Build: pass; Unit tests: pass; Integration tests: pass; Perf benchmarks: pass; Lint: fixed and pass.
notes_for_release: Arcadia-7b v1.0 added to hosted catalog. Perf profiles included to help automated routing pick correct variant. Documentation includes quantization guidance and recommended presets for Dedicated deployments.
testing_notes: Unit and integration tests added under tests/model_registry; perf harness results attached in tools/perf. Changelog automation covered by idempotency unit test.
user_visible_changes: New model available in catalog: arcadia-7b v1.0. Docs updated with quickstart and quantization guidance. Registry CHANGELOG updated automatically on merge.
